title: [29.x]-Purchase Credit Memo – "Get Return Shipment Lines" fails for Non-Inventory items with "corrective credit memo can only reverse the original posted invoice" error (regression from Bug 636861)
summary: Purchase credit memo retrieval for non-inventory items now works correctly without triggering an error about reversing the original invoice, fixing a regression from an earlier bug fix.
key_points: Fixed 'Get Return Shipment Lines' functionality for non-inventory items in purchase credit memos
Resolves incorrect validation error that prevented creating corrective credit memos
Regression fix related to earlier corrective credit memo logic
Changes applied across all localization layers
Test coverage added for the correction scenario
